english.title: Provide false or misleading information in a Bank of England investigation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in purported compliance with a relevant requirement imposed under Schedule 11 to the Financial Services and Markets Act 2023,

(A)_[provided information knowing it to be]_
(B)_[recklessly provided information that was]_

false or misleading in a material particular
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph132(5) and (7) of Schedule 11 to the Financial Services and Markets Act2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and locationin purported compliance with a relevant requirement imposed under Schedule 11 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2023
provided information knowing it to be false or misleading in a material particular OR
recklessly provided information that was false or misleading in a material particular

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Paragraph 133 of Schedule 11 provides that proceedings for this offence may only be instituted by the Bank or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions (in England and Wales).
